title: Signal: Dependency declared with an either-or range
scope: A package.json file that declares an `||` range that lets two different major lines satisfy one declaration.
limitations: It matches an `||` range that lets two different major lines satisfy one declaration in the parsed package.json; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A generator that writes an either-or range for a compatibility window is still reported; record it as an accepted exception.
